rules.description: C# must be a thin interface only. Zero business logic in C#. WebGL uses jslib fetch, Editor uses UnityWebRequest.
WebGL uses jslib fetch(). Editor uses UnityWebRequest. Both paths in CloudSaveClient.cs selected via #if UNITY_WEBGL && !UNITY_EDITOR.
All Cloud Save operations require a valid access token. Always check AuthManager.IsLoggedIn before calling.
Use AccessToken header for JWT tokens, AuthKey header for non-JWT. Detect via split('.').length == 3.
setPlayerData body MUST be a valid JSON object or array. Bare primitives (numbers, strings) cause 400 errors. Wrap primitives as {"value": x}.
Delete version parameter must be passed as string to jslib (not long/int64). C# long causes pointer corruption in Emscripten.
GetPlayerData response is {data: {key: value}}. NOT nested under player_data. Extract via response.data[key].
CloudSaveClient is standalone REST. Never require MultiplayerClient or data channel connection.
